title: How To Fix Spotify When It Keeps Skipping On Its Own - BGR
summary: Generally speaking, this shouldn't happen. as the Spotify app is pretty consistent. If you're using the Spotify app on your computer, it has a built-in clear cache option in Storage or Data-saving and offline settings (for the mobile app).
